templates.title: Document templates
templates.emptyBody: Templates you create appear here, grouped by document kind.

editor.bodyHint: Use '{{'placeholder_name'}}' for parts filled in automatically when the document is issued.
editor.noPlaceholders: This template uses no automatic data yet.
editor.knownPlaceholdersEmpty: The system has no automatic data for this document kind yet. Placeholders written in the body print as they are.
editor.previewHint: Uses sample values and renders in a frame isolated from this page.

templates.description: The templates used when the school issues letters and documents. One template per kind is the default.
